_comment: Maintained by Claude — see ../CLAUDE.md 'Dashboard Maintenance' rule. Status values: concept | in-progress | review | ready | archived. Keys in 'mocks' are folder paths relative to products/SafeLMS/ (no trailing /index.html).

recentChanges.summary: Added a Status filter dropdown in the Learner Progress table header (All / Intervene / Nudge / On Track / Done-Pass / Done-Fail, each with a color dot and count) as an alternative to clicking the bucket cards. The dropdown and the bucket cards stay in sync — selecting in either updates both — replacing the old 'Filtered:' chip.

Made the Action Needed buckets and the learner table work together: moved the Learner Progress table directly under the buckets (visualizations now sit below). Added per-row action modals with confirmation — Intervene and Nudge (recipient list, send options, editable message), Schedule Retry (failure date / cooldown / eligible-to-retry + new due date), View (On Track learner detail), and Certificate (completion preview + Download PDF). Added row checkboxes on Intervene/Nudge learners with a select-all and a bulk-action bar to send Intervene or Nudge to multiple learners at once; confirmations fire a success toast.
Removed the colored left accent bar from the Action Needed bucket cards on the OSHA Reports view.

Merged dashboard.html into index.html as a single-page shell and deleted dashboard.html. The sidebar's Dashboard, Reports, and OSHA Reports items now switch in-page views instead of navigating away: Dashboard (completions chart + feedback + inner tabs) and OSHA Reports are full views, and Reports embeds the standard SafeLMS reports design (../reports/) in an iframe for side-by-side comparison — so clicking Reports no longer leaves the product or loses access to the OSHA Reports tab. Views are hash-routed (#dashboard / #reports / #osha).

Reworked the OSHA report into a standalone page reached from the new OSHA Reports sidebar item (removed the Dashboard sub-tabs): Action Needed buckets (Intervene / Nudge / On Track / Done-Pass / Done-Fail), learner risk-distribution bar, expiring-certifications card, and a per-learner progress table filterable by bucket.
Moved the pencil banner out of the loading state to the top of the Report Log page (above the log table), shown each time the log opens; mirrored into the dev_handoff build.

Replaced the loading-state info banner with the new pencil-banner component (white card, blue left accent, info icon in a light-blue rounded square, dismiss-only) and updated its copy to "Only the Compliance and Completion reports are saved here while they generate. Refresh the page to see the latest updates."; mirrored into the dev_handoff build.
Rounded the filters and results table cards to 12px with no border and a soft shadow so they float as white cards on the gray canvas, matching the async-reports style.

Restyled the reports area and Report Log as floating white cards (rounded corners, soft shadow, no border) on a gray canvas, fixing the disconnected top-corner line on the log table; mirrored into the dev_handoff build.

Centered the "We'll email you when the report is ready" confirmation toast within the reports/main content area (offset by half the sidebar width) so the sidenav no longer makes it look off-center; mirrored into the dev_handoff build.
Title-cased the email opt-in button label to "Email Me the Report When Ready"; mirrored into the dev_handoff build.
Tightened the loading copy to "This report may take a while. View and download it from the Report Log when it's ready, or opt in below and we'll email you."; mirrored into the dev_handoff build.
Widened the loading message max-width from 380px to 560px so the longer copy reads more comfortably; mirrored into the dev_handoff build.
Rewrote the loading copy to explain the report is logged and downloadable from the Report Log when ready, with an opt-in for email notification; mirrored into the dev_handoff build.
Moved the email confirmation toast to top-center and shortened the loading body text to two lines ("This may take a while." / "Your request has been saved."); mirrored into the dev_handoff build.

Made the "We'll email you when the report is ready" confirmation a floating toast that no longer pushes the report log or data table down, auto-dismisses after 7 seconds, and clears when leaving the view; mirrored into the dev_handoff build.
Split the async report loading copy so each sentence sits on its own row; mirrored the change into the dev_handoff build.
Added a dev-handoff copy of the async reports mock with the comment widget and its annotation attributes stripped out for developer build.
Gave Export Report buttons a fixed min-width so dropdown and single variants match; restyled the header Report Log button to a solid white background with no icon.

Moved Report Log from a tab to a secondary button in the blue header; removed the V1/V2 flow switcher (keeping V1 only); rebuilt the log to show the four PRD target reports without Scheduled/Expired rows; renamed Download to Export Report with a CSV/Excel format dropdown for every report except Completions by Employee.
Reworded the loading copy to reassure users they can close the page and will be emailed when the report is ready.
Swapped the flow switcher versions so V1 is now the Completions-by-Employee flow and V2 is the Compliance-by-Employee flow.
Reworded the V1 modal intro to describe duplicating the selected variant into a customizable Learning Studio course, and changed the warning banner colors from red to orange.

osha-report.title: OSHA Reports
osha-report.description: A single-page LMS shell whose sidebar switches between three in-page views: Dashboard (completions-over-time chart, TOTAL/TODAY stats, employee feedback), the standard SafeLMS Reports design embedded in an iframe for comparison, and OSHA Reports — which turns ClickSafety OSHA course data into Action Needed buckets (Intervene, Nudge, On Track, Done/Pass, Done/Fail), a learner risk-distribution visualization, an expiring-certifications view, and a per-learner progress table filterable by bucket. Clicking Reports opens the reports design in place without leaving OSHA Reports.

async-reports.description: Reports experience with asynchronous, background-generated exports and a Report Log (opened from a secondary button in the blue header) listing the four PRD target reports with CSV/Excel export and View Report actions.

LS integration warning.title: LS Integration Warning
LS integration warning.description: Learning Studio launch modal warning users they are creating an editable copy of a Vector course and are responsible for compliance. Includes a V1/V2 design switcher.

reports.description: SafeLMS reports landing page with training and course completion data tables.

test.description: Experimental scratch space for in-flight SafeLMS prototype work.

timeout modal SAFELMS-30656.description: Warning modal that prompts users when their session is about to expire.
